title: इस बार interview में Priya Ma'am impressed हो गईं
experiment: none: a bet slot and a sequel to the #11 hit (the same job-hunt loss, the win in front of an interviewer, a new tool).
look: illustrated story, my face and body (shirt at the interview, hoodie at home at night), Priya Ma'am as the interviewer, a drawn phone in Live mode, compact captions
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a short story and lets you in on a useful find. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
